skinmod.title: Skin Wardrobe
skinmod.name: Name
skinmod.drop_hint: ✦ Drop a skin PNG anywhere on this window to add it ✦
skinmod.rotate_hint: Drag to turn · Scroll to zoom
skinmod.figura_tip: Pick a Figura avatar (a folder, a .zip or a .rar you add) that loads with this skin. Without one, your current Figura avatar stays. You can also drop a .zip or .rar on this window.
skinmod.talk_tip: A second skin shown while you speak (Plasmo Voice), e.g. with an open mouth.
skinmod.talk_tip_missing: Plasmo Voice is not installed, so this skin will not show until it is.
skinmod.reset_tip: Stop using a custom skin. Everyone sees your normal Minecraft skin again.
skinmod.figura_pick_outfit: Select one of your own outfits first
